title: Dad's First Ride

pre.en: Where did the taxi take Chen's dad?
pre.zh: 出租车把 Chen 的爸爸送到了哪儿？
options: Back to his own front door

intro: 一个小故事：Chen 的爸爸坐了十一年公交车去下棋，这个星期天，Chen 在视频里教他用打车软件。读的时候留意名词后面直接跟的分词短语：an app used by almost everyone、the neighbours sitting in the courtyard。过去分词表示被动，现在分词表示主动，都是把定语从句说短了。

sentences.en: For eleven years, Chen's dad, who's 64 now, has taken the number 9 bus to his chess club.
sentences.zh: 十一年来，小陈的爸爸——如今 64 岁了——一直坐 9 路公交车去象棋俱乐部。

sentences.en: He usually waits twenty minutes at a stop with no roof.
sentences.zh: 他通常要在一个没顶棚的车站等二十分钟。

sentences.en: He's lost three umbrellas on that bus, and he's never got one back.
sentences.zh: 他在那趟车上丢过三把伞，一把都没找回来。

sentences.en: Every winter, he makes a complaint to the bus company, and every winter nothing changes.
sentences.zh: 每年冬天他都向公交公司投诉，每年冬天都没有任何变化。

sentences.en: So on Sunday, during their video call on the new tablet, Chen decided to show him how to use a taxi app.
sentences.zh: 所以星期天用新平板视频的时候，小陈决定教爸爸用打车软件。

sentences.en: It's an app used by almost everyone in Chengdu, and you can pay for the trip later.
sentences.zh: 成都几乎人人都在用这个软件，车费还可以过后再付。

sentences.en: Dad took notes on the back of an envelope lying on the table.
sentences.zh: 爸爸拿起桌上的一个信封，在背面记笔记。

sentences.en: "It's like going back to college at sixty-four," he said.
sentences.zh: 「这就跟 64 岁又回学校念书一样。」他说。

sentences.en: He typed in an address and went back and forth between "Confirm" and "Cancel" for a whole minute.
sentences.zh: 他输了一个地址，在「确认」和「取消」之间来回犹豫了整整一分钟。

sentences.en: Finally, he pressed "Confirm".
sentences.zh: 最后，他按下了「确认」。

sentences.en: A message came up: a white car driven by a Mr Guo was on its way.
sentences.zh: 屏幕上跳出一条消息：一位姓郭的师傅开着一辆白色的车，正在赶来。

sentences.en: Well, what could go wrong?
sentences.zh: 嗯，还能出什么岔子呢？

sentences.en: Four minutes later, the car pulled up outside the gate.
sentences.zh: 四分钟后，车停在了小区大门外。

sentences.en: The neighbours sitting in the courtyard all stopped talking to watch.
sentences.zh: 坐在院子里的邻居们都不说话了，全都看着。

sentences.en: Mum said he was only showing off, but he just laughed it off.
sentences.zh: 妈妈说他就是在显摆，他笑笑没当回事。

sentences.en: He waved at everyone from the back seat.
sentences.zh: 他坐在后座上，冲大家挥了挥手。

sentences.en: Mr Guo would drop him off right outside the club.
sentences.zh: 郭师傅会把他直接送到俱乐部门口。

sentences.en: He'd be there in no time.
sentences.zh: 要不了多久就到了。

sentences.en: And he'd never have to ask anyone to give him a lift again.
sentences.zh: 以后他再也不用求人捎他一程了。

sentences.en: Mum turned the tablet to the window so that Chen could see.
sentences.zh: 妈妈把平板转向窗户，好让小陈也能看到。

sentences.en: The white car went slowly round the block and stopped outside the same gate again.
sentences.zh: 那辆白色的车慢慢绕着街区开了一圈，又停在了同一个大门外。

sentences.en: Dad had booked a trip from his own front door to his own front door.
sentences.zh: 原来爸爸订的行程，是从自家门口到自家门口。

sentences.en: Mr Guo drove him round the block, helped him out, and gave him five stars.
sentences.zh: 郭师傅载他绕了一圈，扶他下了车，还给他打了五颗星。

cards.note: 复数 roofs，不是 rooves。
重音在第二个音节 /ʌmˈbrelə/。
to have something again after you lost it or gave it to someone
to tell a company or person officially that you are not happy about something

cards.zh: 教某人怎么做；给某人示范
cards.note: to teach someone to do something by doing it in front of them or explaining it step by step
cards.tip: sb 放在 show 后面，how to 后面接动词原形；不说 show sb to do。
cards.example: Can you show me how to change the printer settings?

cards.note: to write down information while you are listening to someone or reading something
cards.tip: notes 用复数；动词用 take，不用 write。
cards.example: She took notes all through the training day.

cards.note: on the back of an envelope 常指「随手记、粗略算」。
to start studying again at a college after a long time away from education
cards.tip: college 前面不加 the；这里是爸爸开玩笑，说学打车软件像重新上学。
cards.example: After the children left home, she went back to college to study design.

cards.note: to keep changing your opinion or decision
名词 confirmation；订单确认邮件是 a confirmation email。
to be travelling towards a place and arriving soon
cards.tip: its 跟着主语变：I'm on my way、they're on their way；外卖、打车软件里常见。
cards.example: Your food is on its way — it should arrive in ten minutes.

cards.note: to stop happening or working in the way you planned
cards.tip: What could go wrong? 常是说反话：说完这句，往往就要出事了。
cards.example: Everything went wrong on the day of the wedding.

cards.note: if a vehicle pulls up, it stops somewhere for a short time
cards.tip: 主语是车或开车的人；停在哪儿用 outside / in front of / at。
cards.example: A taxi pulled up in front of the hotel.

cards.note: 机场登机口也叫 gate。
court + yard；指楼房围起来的空地。
to laugh about something to show that it does not worry or upset you
to take someone somewhere in a car and leave them there
cards.tip: sb 是代词时放中间：drop me off；反过来「去接人」是 pick sb up。
cards.example: I'll drop you off at the station on my way to work.

cards.note: very soon or very quickly
cards.tip: 可放句首或句尾；也说 in next to no time，更强调快。
cards.example: Don't worry, the kids will be asleep in no time.

cards.note: to take someone somewhere in your car
cards.tip: 英式说法；美式多说 give sb a ride。lift 在英式里也是「电梯」。
cards.example: Could you give me a lift to the airport tomorrow?

cards.note: 一栋公寓楼英式叫 a block of flats。
